prompt: Use an instructor-provided unseen disposable local service-and-team case, or a learner-created and held-back unseen case, materially different from LES-0031 guided fixtures and answered scenarios. It must contain an ambiguous reliability promise, mixed work categories, at least two toil candidates, one automation proposal, incomplete ownership, a production-readiness decision, an on-call or human-sustainability risk, and conflicting product/engineering priorities. After the independence gate, do not open ASM-0076, ASM-0077, the lesson's complete-answer or product-company sections, or generated solutions. Produce a sanitized evidence package that maps users to decisions, classifies work without blaming people, calculates supported risk/work/return values, ranks at least six hypotheses, performs a no-go/limited/go readiness review, proposes a safe operating-model improvement, and gives a five-minute interview explanation with at least twelve explicit proof limits.
deliverables: Completed independence, authorization, environment, help, accessibility and sanitization gate before analysis
User, service, journey, good/total population, reliability objective, business-risk owner and consequence contract
Text architecture linking product decisions, development, SRE or operations, service dependencies, telemetry, on-call, incident response and learning
Raw sanitized work, alert, change, incident, readiness, ownership and user-outcome evidence with time, scope, units and proof limits
Work taxonomy separating toil, non-toil operations, engineering and overhead with reasons and uncertainty
At least six ranked falsifiable hypotheses about service and operating-model failure, each with confirming and rejecting evidence
Risk, work allocation, toil load, automation return, ownership coverage or readiness calculations only where supported
Production-readiness decision with blockers, accepted risks, non-waivable constraints, owners, evidence, expiry and re-review triggers
Safe staged improvement with authorization, protected coverage, canary, abort, rollback, manual fallback and cleanup
Human-sustainability analysis covering pager load, staffing, qualification, escalation, handoff, fatigue and psychological safety
Ninety-day operating review with user, system, change, work, ownership, on-call and learning measures
Five-minute interview explanation and at least twelve technically precise non-claims
evidenceRequirements: The case was unseen and materially different from published guided and answered scenarios
The learner was authorized only for the disposable local case and recorded every form of help received
No personal names, employer names, customer data, secrets, private paths, real tickets, real pager endpoints or confidential organization information are submitted
Every claim links to sanitized raw evidence or a declared calculation, or is labeled inference, hypothesis, estimate or unknown
Team labels, job titles, dashboards, checklists and silence are never treated as proof of SRE adoption, user health or readiness
Work is classified using context and multiple properties rather than personal preference or blame
Automation estimates include build, maintenance, adoption, failure, security, opportunity cost and uncertainty where data permits
Missing required evidence remains missing unless a named authorized owner accepts bounded risk with rationale, controls, expiry and follow-up
No production, shared, employer, online cloud, ticket, identity, notification, email, chat or pager system is modified or contacted
Cleanup proves exact absence of every file, process, port, container, queue or other resource the local case was allowed to create
A qualified reviewer confirms no answer leakage, fabricated evidence, unsafe change, blame narrative or mastery inflation

rubric.observableEvidence: Unseen case, declared help, safe scope, sanitization, raw evidence and no answer leakage or fabrication.
Journey, population, objective, consequence, business owner and uncertainty are explicit.
Decision and production feedback paths name owners, authority, handoffs, conflicts and gaps.
Work categories use multiple properties, measured populations and non-blaming context.
At least six hypotheses are ranked, falsifiable and tested at discriminating boundaries.
Supported math has matched populations, units, assumptions, uncertainty and omitted-cost limits.
Decision distinguishes blockers, accepted risks, non-waivable controls, owners, expiry and re-review.
Plan protects coverage and includes canary, abort, rollback, fallback, user proof and exact cleanup.
Pager load, staffing, qualification, escalation, fatigue, psychological safety and learning loop are actionable.
Five-minute response is clear and at least twelve non-claims are technically specific.
